headline: European soccer live updates: Brentford in control vs. sloppy Spurs
Everton start Premier League campaign with 2-0 win over Crystal Palace as Prime Minister attends
description: Thierno Barry scored in Everton's comfortable 2-0 Premier League victory over Crystal Palace to give manager David Moyes one less thing to worry about -- for now.

headline: Carrick describes opening game defeat to Hull City as 'hugely disappointing'
description: Carrick describes opening game defeat to Hull City as 'hugely disappointing'.

headline: Ipswich Town mark Premier League return with win over Sunderland as Jack Clarke pops up late
description: Jack Clarke fired newly-promoted Ipswich to an opening-day victory with a 90th-minute winner to down old club Sunderland.

headline: Anton Stack free kick helps Leeds beat Nottingham Forest
description: Anton Stach's late free kick saw Leeds kick off their Premier League campaign with a 1-0 win at Nottingham Forest.

headline: Bruno Fernandes: 'Same mistakes, every away game' to blame for Man United loss to Hull
description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes said the "same mistakes" were responsible for his side's shock 2-0 defeat to newly-promoted Hull City in their opening game of the Premier League season on Saturday.
